a: Secure cookies are only sent over HTTPS.
HttpOnly blocks document.cookie access, reducing XSS impact.
Strict is tightest; Lax allows top-level GETs; None needs Secure.
Scope cookies narrowly by Domain and Path.
Session cookies die with the browser; persistent use Max-Age/Expires.
Browsers limit cookie count and size per domain.
HttpOnly + Secure + short TTL + rotation + CSP.
Third-party cookies are being phased down; design without relying on them.
Set-Cookie headers set cookies; do not expose them to untrusted JS.
